title: Non-Archimedean Rigidity and Uniformity for Common Preperiodic Points
summary: Let $k$ be an algebraically closed, complete non-Archimedean field of residue characteristic $0$. Let $f$ be a polynomial of degree at least $2$ over $k$ which does not have potential good reduction. We prove that if $g$ is any other polynomial with the same Julia set, then $f$ and $g$ must be dynamically related.
